data.summary: Markets operations professional with 3 years of experience across securities settlements, post-trade operations, exception management, reconciliations, operational controls, and corporate action income processing within global wealth management operations. Experienced in managing end-to-end settlement workflows across Equities, Fixed Income, Structured Products, and FX-related processes, investigating settlement fails and cash breaks, coordinating with custodians and brokers, and working to market deadlines and operational SLAs. Strong track record in root-cause analysis, risk mitigation, process improvement, and automation of repetitive operational workflows using Excel-based solutions. Experienced in supporting regulatory and market-driven change, including the US T+1 settlement transition.

responsibilities: Own daily settlement controls across multiple European and emerging markets, monitoring trade status, pre-matching exceptions, settlement instruction mismatches, market deadlines, and aged fails to support timely settlement and reduce operational risk.

Investigate and resolve settlement exceptions involving trade economics, pricing, settlement instructions, counterparty mismatches, and internal processing issues; perform root-cause analysis and coordinate corrective actions with internal teams and external parties.
Perform daily cash reconciliations between internal books and custodian records, investigate breaks and missing cash flows, and drive exceptions through timely resolution.
Monitor potential buy-in exposure and fail risk, applying market-specific timelines, notice periods, and escalation requirements to prevent avoidable costs and client impact.
Coordinate with custodians, brokers, middle office, risk, and other stakeholders to resolve high-priority settlement issues and improve operational outcomes.
Track operational queues and exception ageing against deadlines and SLAs, prioritizing high-value, client-critical, and market-cutoff-sensitive items.

Managed end-to-end post-trade settlement workflows, including pre-matching, instruction validation, settlement monitoring, fail investigation, exception resolution, and escalation across domestic and international markets.
Used SWIFT and market/custodian information to investigate trade and settlement discrepancies, liaising with brokers and custodians to resolve breaks and support value-date settlement.
Investigated failed trades, identified underlying causes, coordinated remediation, and implemented preventive controls to reduce recurring settlement issues and financial exposure.
Supported the 2024 US market transition from T+2 to T+1 by adapting operational monitoring and settlement processes to compressed timelines and heightened exception-management requirements.

Identified repetitive manual activities and developed automation solutions for pre-matching notifications, settlement queue monitoring, email categorization, urgent-item flagging, and turnaround-time reporting.

Improved workflow efficiency and settlement turnaround through process enhancements while maintaining records of settlements, reconciliations, exceptions, and escalations for control and audit requirements.
Created and validated corporate action income events and supported accurate processing of dividends, interest, and redemption payments in line with market standards and internal controls.
Performed control checks over event setup and payment processing, investigated discrepancies, and used SWIFT messaging to support timely and accurate cash-flow processing.
